title: How Developers Configure LLM Inference: A Large-Scale Study of Real-World Practices
abstract: arXiv:2610.27945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly integrated into software systems, making deployment and inference configuration a recurring software engineering task. Inference backends expose many options that affect model loading, generation, serving, and request processing. Yet little is known about which of these options developers explicitly configure in practice. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical study of LLM inference configuration practices in open-source software using Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and the OpenAI API. We analyze 5,398 GitHub repositories using at least one of these backends and identify 345,117 explicitly configured option occurrences. Our results show that developers use only a small part of the available configuration space regularly. translated_title: 开发者如何配置大语言模型推理：对真实世界实践的大规模研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被集成到软件系统中，使得部署和推理配置成为一项经常性的软件工程任务。推理后端暴露了大量影响模型加载、生成、服务以及请求处理的选项。然而，人们对开发者在实践中实际显式配置了哪些选项知之甚少。在本文中，我们对开源软件中使用 Hugging Face Transformers、vLLM 和 OpenAI API 的 LLM 推理配置实践开展了一项大规模实证研究。我们分析了 5,398 个至少使用其中一种后端的 GitHub 仓库，并识别出 345,117 次显式配置选项的出现。我们的结果表明，开发者通常只使用可用配置空间中的一小部分。尽管 98.8% 的已记录的后端特定选项至少出现过一次，但其中 78.9% 的选项仅在至多 10% 的使用相应后端的仓库中被配置。配置是……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对 5,398 个 GitHub 仓库的大规模实证研究，系统揭示了开发者在使用 Hugging Face Transformers、vLLM 和 OpenAI API 时的真实 LLM 推理配置实践，发现开发者实际常规使用的配置选项仅占可用配置空间的一小部分。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a large-scale empirical study of 5,398 GitHub repositories to reveal real-world LLM inference configuration practices across Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and the OpenAI API, finding that developers regularly use only a small fraction of the available configuration space.
